summary: Flathead County, MT L-4 cab built in 1932 and destroyed in 1956 per firelookout.com; the FFLA list agrees it is gone, and no source describes any remains.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1956 per firelookout.com; FFLA status Gone; beyond that status, no source describes what remains at the site

evidence.supports: built 1932 as an L-4 cab; destroyed 1956
location 11 miles southeast of Hungry Horse
agency named as Flathead National Forest
FFLA lists the site as ground type with status gone, at coordinates 48.24418, -113.92563

notes_for_editor: Record kind 'ground' and status 'gone' both match the FFLA list. firelookout.com says only 'L-4 cab', so the ground-level classification rests on the FFLA list alone. The build and destruction years, elevation and forest name come from firelookout.com alone. Two pages read; no staffing or fire information found.
